title: TWITTER Gravel V3 carbon frameset instruction-manual mirror
notes: Independent exact-model mirror, not a TWITTER-owned publication. It identifies the matching 45 / 48 / 51 / 54 press-fit Gravel V3 generation, publishes a 700x40C maximum, approximately 1.25 kg frame and 0.49 kg fork, and provides the four-size geometry table. The BB86 label still conflicts with the retained seller table's BB92 wording.
